info.cls_ename: Ph.D Program in Mechanical and Aeronautical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 訓練學生學習創新性研究，學生與指導教授針對研究問題進行研究發展和設計。然後撰寫研究論文和研究的結果
description.describe_eh: The course will teach and conduct an original empirical research study. The student with faculty member as a primary advisor to work with. The student must to develop a research project to collect and analyze data and to investigate the research question. The study results are then written up in a thesis.
